import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
cases = [
    ('A="line\\nnext"', 'line\nnext'),
    ("A='it\\'s'", "it's"),
    ('A="a\\\\b"', 'a\\b'),
    ('A="\\t"', '\t'),
    ("A='no\\nescape'", 'no\\nescape'),
    ('A=C:\\path\\n', 'C:\\path\\n'),
]
for text, expected in cases:
    val = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))[0].value
    print(repr(text), '->', repr(val), 'OK' if val == expected else f'FAIL expected {expected!r}')
EOF
